title: 災難復原與備份演練
summary: 以RPO、RTO 與獨立還原證據連結 16 個技術單元，新增 32 步原理、架構、假想算例、實驗設計與失效驗證。
summaryEn: Sixteen technical units connect rpo, rto and independent restore evidence through 32 new tasks covering principles, architecture, assumed calculations, experiment design and failure validation.
scope: 公開原理的雙語工程教育；工作臺是概念模擬，不是特定廠商產品的完整模擬器。數值為自行設定的教學假設。實驗僅限離線模型、自己的隔離環境或明確授權的測試資料；不掃描或改動真實第三方系統，未測平臺保留未決。
scopeEn: Bilingual engineering education from public principles; the workbench is a conceptual simulation, not a complete simulator of any vendor product. Inputs are original teaching assumptions. Experiments use offline models, owned isolated environments or explicitly authorized test data, never scan/modify third-party systems and leave untested platforms unresolved.

stages.title: 業務目標與範圍
stages.description: 四個技術單元以原理／架構與實驗／驗證兩步完成「業務目標與範圍」；每步獨立保存進度與知識測驗。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop business goals and scope through separate principle/architecture and experiment/validation tasks with saved progress and knowledge checks.

steps.title: RPO：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「RPO」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for rpo.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「RPO」的資料、控制與時間關係。可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「標出最後可恢復提交點。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for rpo. Tolerable loss needs time/event boundaries. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Mark the last recoverable commit. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.observation: 標出最後可恢復提交點。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：備份工作成功就證明 RTO 已達成。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Successful backup jobs prove RTO compliance. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「RPO」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit rpo two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: RPO的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。

knowledge.title: RPO的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 標出最後可恢復提交點。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Mark the last recoverable commit. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

knowledge.title: 本課原創量化算例
knowledge.text: 假設 2 TB 十進位基底以持續 400 MB/s 還原，純資料搬移下界=5000 s≈83.3 min；需重播 120 GB 日誌、200 MB/s 約 10 min，串列合計至少 93.3 min，未含驗證、配置及索引。
knowledge.textEn: Restoring assumed 2 decimal TB at sustained 400 MB/s takes at least 5000 s≈83.3 min. Replaying 120 GB logs at 200 MB/s adds 10 min serially, for at least 93.3 min excluding checks, setup and indexes.

quiz.question: 本步審查「RPO」與整體「災難復原與備份演練」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing rpo within disaster recovery and backup exercises, which statement or check is supported?
options: 可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。
備份工作成功就證明 RTO 已達成。
資料有副本就不需保存解密金鑰。
optionsEn: Tolerable loss needs time/event boundaries.
Successful backup jobs prove RTO compliance.
Data replicas remove the need to retain decryption keys.
quiz.explanation: 可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。 標出最後可恢復提交點。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Tolerable loss needs time/event boundaries. Mark the last recoverable commit. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: RPO：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「標出最後可恢復提交點。」檢查「RPO」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for rpo using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「RPO」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：標出最後可恢復提交點。 核對「可容忍資料損失需用時間或事件界定。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for rpo and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Mark the last recoverable commit. Check the principle: Tolerable loss needs time/event boundaries. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.observation: 標出最後可恢復提交點。
steps.failure: 常見誤判：備份工作成功就證明 RTO 已達成。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Successful backup jobs prove RTO compliance. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「RPO」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「標出最後可恢復提交點。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit rpo input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.

steps.objective: 以「故障範圍」建立可檢查的架構、原理與驗證依據。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish reviewable architecture, principles and evidence for failure scope.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，辨識「故障範圍」的資料、控制與時間關係。磁碟、帳號與區域失效不同。 在離線工作臺畫出元件／資料流，列出輸入、輸出、保存狀態與合法轉移；建立基準與擾動兩種假想情境，寫下可被反駁的預測。以「建立三類演練情境。」設計下一步驗證。記錄版本、單位、未知參數與模型外的行為。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor and identify data, control and timing relationships for failure scope. Disk, account and regional failures differ. Draw components/data flows offline; specify inputs, outputs, retained state and legal transitions. Build baseline and perturbed hypothetical cases and make a falsifiable prediction. Plan validation using: Build three exercise scenarios. Record versions, units, unknowns and out-of-model behavior.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料有副本就不需保存解密金鑰。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Data replicas remove the need to retain decryption keys. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「故障範圍」的兩情境架構／狀態圖、參數表與可反駁預測；標出哪些資料支援「磁碟、帳號與區域失效不同。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit failure scope two-case architecture/state diagrams, parameter table and falsifiable prediction; identify evidence supporting the principle.

knowledge.title: 故障範圍的原理與邊界
knowledge.text: 磁碟、帳號與區域失效不同。
knowledge.textEn: Disk, account and regional failures differ.

knowledge.title: 故障範圍的驗證設計
knowledge.text: 建立三類演練情境。 保留基準與擾動的完整輸入／輸出，以語義、容量或時間條件檢查，並明列假想模型未涵蓋的現實因素。
knowledge.textEn: Build three exercise scenarios. Retain complete inputs/outputs for baseline and perturbation, check semantic/capacity/timing criteria and state real-world factors omitted from the hypothetical model.

quiz.question: 本步審查「故障範圍」與整體「災難復原與備份演練」時，哪項陳述或驗證有依據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing failure scope within disaster recovery and backup exercises, which statement or check is supported?
options: 磁碟、帳號與區域失效不同。
備份工作成功就證明 RTO 已達成。
資料有副本就不需保存解密金鑰。
optionsEn: Disk, account and regional failures differ.
Successful backup jobs prove RTO compliance.
Data replicas remove the need to retain decryption keys.
quiz.explanation: 磁碟、帳號與區域失效不同。 建立三類演練情境。 其餘選項混淆不同架構或證據的適用邊界。
quiz.explanationEn: Disk, account and regional failures differ. Build three exercise scenarios. The alternatives confuse architectural or evidence boundaries.

steps.title: 故障範圍：實驗與驗證
steps.objective: 用「建立三類演練情境。」檢查「故障範圍」的假設、結果及失效邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Validate assumptions, outcomes and failure boundaries for failure scope using the specified experiment.
steps.instruction: 重播師傅對「故障範圍」的示範，在自己的隔離模型或試算表執行：建立三類演練情境。 核對「磁碟、帳號與區域失效不同。」是否成立；保留輸入、預期、實際結果與差異。至少提出兩個競爭原因，選擇一項能區分它們的新增觀察。依事前定義的語義、容量或延遲條件判斷通過／保留，未執行的真實平臺項目不得標為實測。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the mentor for failure scope and execute in your own isolated model or worksheet: Build three exercise scenarios. Check the principle: Disk, account and regional failures differ. Preserve input, expected output, observed output and differences. Propose two competing causes and a discriminating observation. Apply predefined semantic, capacity or latency criteria and mark untested real-platform claims unresolved.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：資料有副本就不需保存解密金鑰。 本步需分開功能正確、資源上界與證據範圍，不可把假想結果當作真實平臺保證。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Data replicas remove the need to retain decryption keys. Separate correctness, resource bounds and evidence scope; hypothetical results are not real-platform guarantees.
steps.check: 提交「故障範圍」的輸入與結果對照、競爭原因、接受／保留理由；逐項說明「建立三類演練情境。」的證據與尚未驗證範圍。
steps.checkEn: Submit failure scope input/output comparisons, competing causes and pass/hold rationale; state evidence and untested scope for the experiment.
